prompt.npc_style: 自然、简短、符合 Stardew Valley NPC 的语气
prompt.tool_instruction: Use available tools only when the NPC should take an environment action. Use present_dialogue when the player should choose from reply options or enter free text; omitting reply_options and allow_free_text=false means the conversation ends after the NPC line is shown. Use speak for a plain one-line NPC remark without player replies. Use emote for clear visible emotion, and face_player when the NPC should turn toward the player.
